services.name: Dance class
services.desc: Dr. Sketchy’s Anti-Art School is the world’s premier alt-drawing movement, where artists draw glamorous underground performers in an atmosphere of boozy conviviality. Grab you sketch materials and join us to draw uniquely beautiful models. No instructors looming over your shoulder here, and absolutely no drawing experience is necessary to get in on the fun, you just need to be 18 or older. Dr. Sketchy’s is a fun cocktail of drawing, drinks, and dazzling performers. Started by artist Molly Crabapple in 2005, Dr. Sketchy’s is based on Molly’s harebrained dream of a “decadent” art class with fair pay and respect for the models and boozy fun for all, and has branches in over a hundred cities

services.desc: Modern Dance class for every level, every body. Come for the movement, stay for the community. See you on the floor 🩰 Our Community Modern Class is an intermediate-advanced modern dance class built for dancers who want to train, move honestly, and stay connected to the city's dance community. Taught by Artistic Director Amber Daniels. This class is about showing up, getting sweaty, taking risks, and dancing alongside other Baltimore artists in a space that values grit, curiosity, and care.
